review_source.method: read-only source/test inventory; no tests/builds run

coverage_summary: All six Section-D integrated proofs remain incomplete. Existing tests provide useful lower-level or adjacent evidence but do not establish the specified multi-document/server lifecycle, release/provider parity, or shipped-host behavior.

scenarios.name: Package selection in one server process

existing_selectors.coverage: Checks Tcl package version selection and definition target for several requirements; constructs a fresh backend for each row, so it does not test inter-document isolation/order in one server process.
One document-local auto_path package resolution.
Folder/global declared provides config selection, not two discovered release providers and shared-server query order.

missing_proofs: Two release roots outside scan root; multiple entry documents require distinct releases and query A→B→A plus B→A→B in one server instance.
Unavailable higher registration and Unicode autoload name.
Change requirement/library path and assert old provider disappears from first settled result.

scenarios.name: Inherited source state and deep chains

existing_selectors.coverage: Closed sourced file rename retires old path and checks source rehoming; basic case only.
Namespace inherited by sourced declarations.
Constant source path resolution within a source file.
Mixed source-site convergence at a bounded graph.

missing_proofs: A 7–12 file literal source chain beyond both current depth limits, with source-directory constant after hop five and namespace composition after hop four.
Same child sourced under two known namespaces; remove/change/rename an edge and verify obsolete views disappear.
Independent readiness wait followed by one completed reconciliation; repeated naming queries must not advance state or conceal truncation.

scenarios.name: Warm versus fresh lifecycle answers

existing_selectors.coverage: Closed deleted file leaves workspace index.
Closed-file deletion reschedules open cross-file diagnostics.
Deletion invalidation reaches a non-cross-file document.
Watched closed-file change refreshes the diagnostic badge.
Direct disk reindex updates the indexed file.

missing_proofs: Warm definitions/references/diagnostics, edit through didChange, then repeat with watched change to a closed provider.
Compare the first completed new-revision answers against a fresh server; prove no cached old result or stale publication survives.

scenarios.name: Environment changes without text edits

existing_selectors.coverage: Pack file appears after startup; open document receives new hover fact without a document edit.
Pack body reload publishes a new analysis answer; document also receives a text edit.
Removed pack no longer advertises its extension.
Pack-declared environment routing.
Stale startup pack set cannot overwrite later set.

missing_proofs: Change/remove/restore folder dialect plus custom pack/stub while document text remains fixed.
Include an unopened provider and a source-seeded consumer; check naming, aliases and argument roles across all providers/workspace gates.
Assert new generation and no late publication from the prior environment.

scenarios.name: Actual protocol edits and provider agreement

existing_selectors.coverage: Basic declaration/call rename.
Call-origin rename.
Cross-document duplicate declaration selection.
References and rename agree on selected method sites.

existing_selectors.scope: native LSP e2e plus interpreter check
existing_selectors.coverage: Applies returned edit and runs a focused transformed source against a selected Tcl oracle.

missing_proofs: Declaration-origin and call-origin protocol edits across open/closed files, imports/aliases, class/method collisions, and Unicode/UTF-16 ranges.
Apply complete WorkspaceEdit to scratch source and run the matching interpreter for each matched case/release.
Prove definitions, references, diagnostics, quick fixes and enabled optimize/minify commands agree on the same identities; current direct edit cases cover subsets only.

scenarios.name: Shipped transports and editor hosts

existing_selectors.coverage: Native protocol route for a Jim-dialect document.
Bundled EDA commands known in the native server.
Harness exists; CI run 39616304947 reached six naming-adjacent checks and failed pack hover, workspace scan, sourced definition, workspace symbols, tclIndex autoload and pack notices.
Harness exists; CI run 39616304947 passed 22 unit tests but failed seven host behavior checks, including diagnostics/source navigation/cache/lifecycle.

missing_proofs: Complete native JSON-RPC, browser/WASM and WASI test runs with file/VFS updates, effective dialect/pack propagation and edit application.
Naming-specific host acceptance remains unproven; cited CI observations are failures, and editor web partitions stopped before host assertions.

lsp_server: Section-D targets are integrated server behavior; direct compiler/registry/unit tests do not substitute. All six scenarios remain open to the scope stated above.
The three native e2e partitions in CI 39616304947 were cancelled after 344 observations (273 pass, 71 fail), so their suite provides partial evidence only.
vm_runtime: No general VM/runtime naming migration is required by this review; retain existing architecture where SpecTcl works.
Runtime execution remains a required oracle for transformed-source scenarios (D5), and supported pack evaluation/live-hook behavior is a functional LSP requirement.

Relevant owner-level N17 regressions reported in compiler-codegen-NOTES.md §8: tcl-compiler compile_service::tests::a_variable_reference_ends_where_the_release_scanner_ends_it, and tcl-spectcl/tests/variable_reference_boundaries.rs template and production live const-fold hook cases. The notes report 16 template combinations; this evidence is owner-reported and not an independent build in this audit.

Older W216 failure in fixture review: tcl-compiler/src/analyser/diagnostics/tests.rs::w216_fixed_proposals_match_captured_public_value_examples; current review counts it as requiring an explicit correctness decision, so do not treat it as passing evidence.
shared_oracles: The review requires family/release vectors across C Tcl 8.4–9.1 and pinned latest Jim, retaining expected differences. Existing `issue945` executes one focused transformed-source case; there is no evidence here of full six-scenario × release matrix coverage.

ci_5201_comparison.interpretation: No exact matched rows. This is not zero pass-to-fail: CI-5201 inputs are failure-only lists, their total disagrees with the reported aggregate and shard2 is absent; missing selectors remain unknown.
